INFRA-2.title: KRaft Kafka Cluster — 3-Broker Combined Mode (No ZooKeeper)
INFRA-2.description: 3-broker Kafka cluster in KRaft combined mode. Each node acts as both broker and controller. No ZooKeeper. This is the gating task for INFRA-3 through INFRA-6.

key_decisions.kraft_mode: KAFKA_PROCESS_ROLES=broker,controller on all 3 nodes. Each node participates in both the controller quorum and the data plane.
key_decisions.listeners: 3 listener types per broker: CONTROLLER (29093) for Raft election, PLAINTEXT (9092) for internal inter-broker, PLAINTEXT_HOST (9093/9094/9096) for external client access.
key_decisions.replication: KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR=3 and KAFKA_MIN_INSYNC_REPLICAS=2 — cluster tolerates 1 broker failure without losing writes.
key_decisions.auto_create: KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE=false — topics are explicitly provisioned by create-topics.sh to ensure correct partition counts and configs.

deliverables: kafka-1, kafka-2, kafka-3 services in docker-compose.yml (confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.6.1)

INFRA-3.title: Confluent Schema Registry — BACKWARD Compatibility
INFRA-3.description: Schema Registry as the data governance layer for all Avro-serialized events. BACKWARD compatibility enforced globally — consumers are never broken by producer schema upgrades.

key_decisions.compatibility: BACKWARD globally (not FULL or NONE). Producers can add optional fields with defaults. Existing consumers reading older messages will never fail.
key_decisions.replication: KAFKASTORE_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR=3 — the internal _schemas topic is replicated like all other production topics.
key_decisions.dependency: depends_on: service_healthy for all 3 brokers — Schema Registry will not start until the full Kafka quorum is available.

deliverables: infra/scripts/configure-schema-registry.sh — idempotent, sets BACKWARD via REST API PUT /config
INFRA-3.notes: Run bash infra/scripts/configure-schema-registry.sh after docker compose up to set BACKWARD compatibility.

INFRA-4.description: Provectus kafka-ui for browser-based visual management. Enables topic inspection, message browsing (with Avro deserialization), consumer group lag viewing, and schema registry exploration.

INFRA-5.title: JMX Exporter + Prometheus + Grafana Observability Stack

phase_2.name: Telemetry Simulator & Avro Producer

key_decisions.delivery_semantics: enable.idempotence=true + acks=all + retries=MAX_VALUE — exactly-once at producer side. Prevents duplicates at 10k events/sec.
key_decisions.batching: batch.size=65536 (64KB) + linger.ms=5 + compression.type=lz4 — ~60% network reduction under high throughput.
key_decisions.partitioning: Custom TelemetryPartitioner: Math.abs(carId.hashCode()) % numPartitions — all events for the same car land on the same partition, enabling ordered Kafka Streams windowed aggregations in Phase 3.
key_decisions.avro_schema: Full 26-field schema from day one (tire wear, ERS, g-force, DRS, sector). BACKWARD compatibility means new optional fields can be added safely without breaking Phase 3/5 consumers.
key_decisions.simulation_threading: ScheduledExecutorService pool-size=4, delay computed from events-per-second config. 20 cars × configured rate. Configurable without code change.
key_decisions.dlq_design: Separate KafkaTemplate<String, byte[]> for DLQ — no Avro serialization, RETRIES=0, ACKS=1. DLQ failures must never block the main pipeline.
key_decisions.java_version: Java 21 (LTS) — virtual threads available, modern records/pattern matching, amazoncorretto:21-alpine keeps Docker image small.

phase_3.name: Stream Enrichment — Kafka Streams + Debezium CDC

stack.cdc: Debezium PostgreSQL Connector 2.7.4.Final (Maven: debezium-connector-postgres) via Kafka Connect 7.6.1
stack.joins: GlobalKTable leftJoin (circuit + driver) against KStream<String, TelemetryEvent>

key_decisions.wal_level: wal_level=logical required by Debezium pgoutput plugin. max_replication_slots=4 and max_wal_senders=4 set on postgres startup command.
key_decisions.debezium_smt: Three-transform chain: unwrap (remove Debezium envelope), route (rename topic), extractKey (plain String PK). This gives clean String keys for GlobalKTable lookups without struct-key complexity.
key_decisions.global_ktable: GlobalKTable instead of KTable: Global = all partitions replicated to every stream thread. No co-partitioning requirement. circuit-metadata (10 rows) and driver-profiles (20 rows) are tiny — full replication is free.
key_decisions.left_join: leftJoin not join: events pass through even if reference data hasn't arrived yet. enriched=false when circuit/driver is null. No blocking or data loss at startup.
key_decisions.circuit_id_extraction: session_id='RACE_2024_MONZA_R1' → split('_')[2] = 'MONZA'. Must match PostgreSQL circuits.circuit_id exactly.
key_decisions.exactly_once: processing.guarantee=exactly_once_v2. Kafka Streams uses transactions internally. Prevents enriched-telemetry duplicates on processor restart.
key_decisions.plugin_mount: Debezium JAR downloaded locally and volume-mounted — no custom Docker image build. Faster iteration, same result.
key_decisions.publication_per_connector: Separate publication.name per Debezium connector (e.g. aerostream_circuits_pub) so filtered publications do not collide on dbz_publication.
key_decisions.route_regex: RegexRouter targets only aerostream.public.circuits / aerostream.public.drivers so heartbeat records are not rewritten through ExtractField$Key.
key_decisions.heartbeat: heartbeat.interval.ms=0 for both CDC connectors to avoid heartbeat records traversing the SMT chain (alternative: predicates).
key_decisions.deploy_connectors: deploy-connectors.sh PUTs config on HTTP 409 so connector JSON changes apply without manual DELETE.
key_decisions.connector_password: Committed connector JSON uses empty database.password; deploy injects POSTGRES_PASSWORD.

decisions.kafka_mode: KRaft combined mode (broker + controller on same node). No ZooKeeper. Requires CLUSTER_ID generated with kafka-storage random-uuid before first start.
decisions.schema_compatibility: BACKWARD globally. New schemas can only add optional fields with defaults. Protects downstream consumers from breaking changes.
decisions.topic_partitions: raw-telemetry and enriched-telemetry = 20 partitions (matches 20 simulated cars). stream-aggregates = 10. pit-predictions = 5. DLQ/metadata = 3.
decisions.replication_factor: RF=3 on all topics. min.insync.replicas=2 on high-throughput topics. Cluster can tolerate 1 broker failure.
decisions.docker_network: Single bridge network aerostream-network. All containers communicate by service name.
decisions.observability: JMX Prometheus Java Agent (0.19.0) attached to each broker via KAFKA_OPTS. Prometheus scrapes at 15s. Grafana with file-provisioned datasource and dashboard provider.
decisions.auto_create_topics: KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE=false — operational topics are provisioned via create-topics.sh where durable configs matter; Phase 4 sink topic stream-aggregates is created by ksqlDB CTAS (matching PARTITIONS/RF); ksqlDB also creates its own internal topics.
